lastCompletedStory.title: Tighten @biomejs/biome from caret to exact pin

nextStoryContext: @biomejs/biome is now pinned exact (2.5.1, no caret) in both package.json devDependencies and bun.lock's workspace devDependencies range entry; the resolved packages entry (`@biomejs/biome@2.5.1` plus its per-platform optionalDependencies) was already exact and is unchanged. `bun install` after the edit reported 'no changes' (0 installs touched), confirming the tightening is caret-to-exact only with no resolution drift. scripts/check-all.ts's lint gate invocation (`bunx biome lint --error-on-warnings`) needed no change since it was already de-tokenized in US-001. Full `bun run check:all` spine is green (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity all ok); one pre-existing biome self-lint info-level notice (`recommended` deprecated in favor of `preset` in biome.json) surfaced but is informational only (not a warning/error) and out of scope for this story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed 2.5.1 is a real published release on the npm registry (registry metadata returned matching name/version). No API/behavior surface was touched by this story (pure devDependency version-spec tightening), so registry existence is the relevant check rather than a docs/API comparison.
